perfume.answer: Asiana's restricted items page limits toiletries including aerosols to 2 litres in total with no single container over 0.5 litre, and bans liquids over 100 ml from the cabin on international routes. Duty-free perfume from Korean airports travels only sealed in a tamper-evident bag.

sections.h: 🧴 What Asiana says about perfume and aerosols
sections.p: From the Asiana "Restricted Items" page (US English version), read on 22 November 2026.

head: Question
Asiana rule
rows: Total not above 2 L, each single article not above 0.5 L
Liquids of 100 ml or less in one transparent 1 L resealable bag, one bag per passenger
Not in the cabin; carry them in checked baggage
Duty-free perfume or alcohol from Korean airports
Only sealed in a security tamper-evident bag
Allowed if sealed in a tamper-evident bag; the transit country may still confiscate it

list: Not on this page: a separate rule for perfume alone beyond the toiletries and duty-free lines above.

faq: How much aerosol or perfume can I check on Asiana?
Toiletries including aerosols up to 2 litres in total, and no single container above 0.5 litre.
Can I carry duty-free perfume on Asiana?
Yes, if it is sealed in a security tamper-evident bag. Transit countries may still confiscate it.
